articles.title: Suspected terrorists trapped as encounter breaks out in Rajouri
articles.summary: Armed forces launched a major cordon-and-search operation in Rajouri district, Jammu & Kashmir, following intelligence on suspected infiltrators. An encounter subsequently broke out, underscoring the continuous vigilance and proactive operations by security forces to counter infiltration bids. This incident highlights ongoing counter-insurgency efforts and the dedication of our armed forces to maintaining national security in the region.

articles.title: Govt wants private sector share in defence production to rise to 50%: Rajnath Singh
articles.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh stated that India aims for its private sector to contribute at least 50% of the nation's defence manufacturing capacity, a significant increase from the current 30%. This strategic push aligns with the 'Make in India' initiative, fostering self-reliance and boosting indigenous production capabilities, thereby strengthening national defence infrastructure and economic growth.

articles.title: Army orders probe into helicopter crash close to LAC
articles.summary: The Indian Army has initiated a probe into a helicopter crash in Ladakh on May 20. Senior commander Major General Sachin Mehta and two pilots were injured in the incident but fortunately survived. This investigation underscores the continuous focus on operational safety within the armed forces and the challenges faced by military personnel during their service.

articles.title: rustima added to PyPI
articles.summary: This article introduces a high-performance SARIMAX (Seasonal ARIMA with eXogenous regressors) engine, developed in Rust with Python bindings via PyO3. It offers a statsmodels-compatible high-level API, facilitating advanced time-series analysis and forecasting. Its native compilation enhances efficiency, providing data scientists and developers a powerful, fast, and easy-to-integrate tool for predictive modeling and data interpretation in various technical applications.

articles.title: SPIC Q4 profit up on better cost control
articles.summary: Southern Petrochemical Industries Corporation Ltd (SPIC) reported a substantial increase in consolidated net profit, reaching 29.5 crore for Q4FY26, up from 19.5 crore last year. This strong financial performance indicates robust growth within the petrochemical sector. Such industrial strength is crucial for India's economic development, contributing significantly to national infrastructure and employment generation, which are vital for overall national progress.

articles.title: Pre-monsoon showers cool Delhi, southwest monsoon advances in Kerala
articles.summary: Delhi-NCR residents received welcome relief from the intense heatwave on Saturday as pre-monsoon showers, cloudy skies, and cool breezes provided temporary respite. This much-needed weather change significantly lowered temperatures across the region, offering immediate comfort. The unexpected downpour made mornings pleasant, mitigating the extreme heat conditions and providing a brief reprieve before the full monsoon arrival.
